args.question:
Acme Supplies (V-628) has two invoices in approved status, so I can't tell which one you mean by "the approved invoice":
- INV-37191 — $3,551.99, due 2026-11-25
- INV-45131 — $6,853.44, due 2026-11-04
(There's also INV-78192 for $4,269.77, but it's still in draft/awaiting approval, and INV-20002 is already paid. No payments have been sent to this vendor yet.)

Which invoice should I pay by wire? Note that you said "the approved invoice" (singular) and "pay it exactly once," so I'll pay only the one you name.

I verified no payments existed to this vendor beforehand, then confirmed afterward that exactly one payment exists (PAY0001) and that INV-37191 alone moved to `paid`.

- INV-78192 — $4,269.77, still `draft` (awaiting approval)

The amount was under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold, so no additional approval was required.
